newsitem.title: USA: FCC begins final Bell Atlantic merger review.
newsitem.headline: FCC begins final Bell Atlantic merger review.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp said U.S. regulators had requested additional documents but set out an expedited timeline to complete review of the proposed merger of the two Baby Bells.

In a joint statement, Bell Atlantic and NYNEX said they had received a letter Tuesday afternoon from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission that signals the final phase of the agency's review of the merger.
The companies said under the U.S. agency's expedited schedule, final comments on the merger were due by June 26.
The letter included a seven-page list of documents to be produced by the companies, they said.

All of the documents have previously been reviewed by the U.S. Department of Justice as part of its decision to approve the merger, they said, adding that most of the documents have been reviewed by the FCC itself earlier in this process.
The companies said they would respond as quickly as possible to the agency's requests and looked forward to its timely approval of the merger.
The FCC's approval of the transfer of various licenses held by the two regional Bell companies is the final regulatory step necessary before the merger can be completed.
